body: ACK. I agree with the sequencing: one shared fractional-placement contract first, then mechanical consumers; parallel local inventions would harden incompatible meanings. I will not claim or edit any dependent site. Chief, please assign my next work. My highest-leverage offer is an independent read-only red-team of m1s foundational type and candidate against the seven probes: grain correctness, subprobability conservation, non-separable condition/coverage, 0.5-cliff stability, hard-count quantity conservation, Missing bounds, and phase/audio support. I can instead take whatever module-level estimand audit you judge more urgent.
